gloss: to come true; to be fulfilled

definitions.gloss: to come true; to be fulfilled; to be realized
definitions.explanation: For a wish, dream, or hope to become reality.

definitions.gloss: to match; to be equal to
definitions.explanation: To be a match for someone in ability (often used in negative).

examples.japanese: {願|ねが}いが{叶|かな}いますように。
{長年|ながねん}の{希望|きぼう}がやっと{叶|かな}った。
examples.english: A long-held wish was finally fulfilled.

examples.japanese: {努力|どりょく}すれば{夢|ゆめ}は{叶|かな}う。
examples.english: If you work hard, your dreams will come true.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}で{働|はたら}きたいという{夢|ゆめ}が{叶|かな}って、とてもうれしい。
examples.english: I'm so happy that my dream of working abroad came true.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}にはとても{叶|かな}わない。
examples.english: I can't compare to the teacher at all.

examples.japanese: {料理|りょうり}の{腕|うで}では{母|はは}には{叶|かな}わない。
examples.english: When it comes to cooking skills, I'm no match for my mother.

examples.japanese: {力|ちから}では{叶|かな}わないが、{知恵|ちえ}では{負|ま}けない。
examples.english: I can't match them in strength, but I won't lose in wits.

examples.japanese: {経験|けいけん}では{先輩|せんぱい}に{叶|かな}わないが、{熱意|ねつい}なら{負|ま}けない。
examples.english: I can't match my senior in experience, but I won't lose in enthusiasm.

notes:
{叶|かな}う is a godan verb with two main meanings.

CONJUGATION:
- {叶|かな}う (dictionary form)
- {叶|かな}わない (negative)
- {叶|かな}った (past)
- {叶|かな}って (te-form)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {夢|ゆめ}が{叶|かな}う: dream comes true
- {願|ねが}いが{叶|かな}う: wish is granted
- 〜には{叶|かな}わない: can't compete with ~

TRANSITIVE FORM:
- {叶|かな}える: to make come true, to grant
